steps.line: Kristopher sits in his car drained after his daily routine of grieving, battling existential dread, and pizza deliveries. He dials the number Violet put on the five dollar bill.
Kristopher steadies himself by saying the Jesus prayer in his mind. Violets phone continues to ring.
Violet realizes if she lets it ring one more time then it will go to voicemail. Time to decide.
Kristopher says over the phone, "Hello? I'm sorry, I tried to hang up and it just wouldn't."
Violet hangs up without a word.
Kristopher texts Violet: "Is this the woman with purple hair who ruins Hawaiian pizza with black olives?"
